notes: Version 2.7 withdraws one interpretive sentence in the paragraph on spectral quasi-fixed points. That sentence read the closeness of the admissibility-weight values a_q(s) q^2 to 2 across the tested primes as consistent with an attractor of the admissible spectral flow independent of q. A rerun of the computation (Gravity version 3.7) shows that this q-independence is no evidence: on pairs whose admissible window has full rank, the modulation terms equal 2 exactly by the normalisation of the fingerprint vectors, and the shift terms are only numerically close to 2 on average, with no proved bound or limit in q. The following sentence now states only that the companion paper Q10 derives no coefficient from the value 2 of the su(2) Casimir. The proposal of spectral quasi-fixed points as candidates for stable structures remains an interpretation, as before. All axioms, theorems and results of the paper are unchanged.
